name: popups-signup-v1
title: Sign-up Popup v1
description: Modal popup with one labelled email field and a primary button, for waitlists and demo requests. Validates inline in a reserved slot, then either crossfades to a thank-you view inside the popup (V1) or closes and hands over to the site (V2, e.g. the Thank-you Bar). Built on the Base Popup: native dialog, focus trap, Escape, overlay click, focus restore, rise-in animation.
